Eli (docs): I'll add an explicit finally/cleanup block in each language sample and swap exponential for 'full jitter' example. sample TS backoff we plan to use:
```js
// full jitter backoff
async function retry(fn, max=5) {
  for (let i=0;i<max;i++){
    try { return await fn() }
    catch(e){
      const base = Math.min(1000 * 2**i, 30000)
      const wait = Math.floor(Math.random()*base)
      await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, wait))
    }
  }
  throw new Error('retries exhausted')
}
```
